'''Mikhail Aleksandrovich Shubin''' (19 December 1944 – 13 May 2020) was an American and Soviet mathematician and professor at [[Northeastern University]], as well as a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].  He died in May 2020 at the age of 75.<ref>[https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.01248 Mikhail Aleksandrovich Shubin death notice]</ref>

==Work==
Shubin has written over 140 papers and books, and supervised almost twenty doctoral theses.

In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title= List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|access-date= 2013-07-18}}</ref>
